ideas.name: any warning after the structure turned
ideas.why: a lower swing high already printed (a higher low, for a long call) means the trend's own swings have started stepping the called way: the warning is the second sign, not the first

ideas.name: a warning confirmed by the next bar
ideas.why: a warning whose next bar closes the called way has price agreeing with it; waiting one bar trades a little entry price for dropping the warnings price ignores

ideas.name: any warning after a trending overnight
ideas.why: an overnight that went one way efficiently (above its 60-session median) is directional inventory; RTH tends to keep going, so turns fail

ideas.name: any warning when quiet for the time of day
ideas.why: the last 15 minutes' bars under 0.7 of their usual size for that clock time: no one is pushing, so a trend that is easing has no fresh orders behind it
